title: Closing the BF16-FP16 Convergence Speed Gap in RL Post-Training with Stochastic Rounding
abstract: arXiv:2611.13545v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: BF16 is widely used to pretrain large language models because it has the same dynamic range as FP32 and converges similarly to FP32 training. However, in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, where learning rates are typically low, we find that standard mixed-precision BF16 training converges more slowly than FP16 training at the same learning rate. We attribute this gap to weight sticking: when FP32 shadow weights are quantized to BF16 using round-to-nearest, small updates often leave the BF16 weights used for rollout generation and training unchanged. Consequently, several optimizer steps may be needed before updates to the shadow weights are reflected in the BF16 weights. Raising the BF16 learning rate reduces weight sticking and matches FP16's convergence speed, but it also increases the KL divergence from the reference model. translated_title: 用随机舍入在强化学习后训练中缩小BF16与FP16的收敛速度差距
translated_abstract: BF16因具有与FP32相同的动态范围、且收敛效果与FP32训练相近，被广泛用于大语言模型的预训练。然而，在采用可验证奖励的强化学习（RL）中，学习率通常较低，我们发现标准混合精度BF16训练在相同学习率下的收敛速度比FP16更慢。我们将这一差距归因于“权重粘滞”（weight sticking）现象：当使用就近舍入（round-to-nearest）方式将FP32影子权重量化为BF16时，较小的更新往往不会改变用于rollout生成和训练的BF16权重。因此，可能需要多次优化器迭代后，影子权重的更新才能体现在BF16权重中。提高BF16学习率可以减少权重粘滞并达到与FP16相当的收敛速度，但同时也会增加与参考模型之间的KL散度。我们转而在将FP32影子权重量化为BF16时应用随机舍入（stochastic rounding）……
tldr: 该论文发现RL后训练中BF16因“权重粘滞”问题收敛慢于FP16，并提出在将FP32影子权重量化为BF16时采用随机舍入，从而在不增加与参考模型KL散度的前提下消除收敛速度差距。
en_tdlr: The paper identifies weight sticking as the cause of BF16's slower convergence than FP16 in RL post-training, and proposes using stochastic rounding when quantizing FP32 shadow weights to BF16, closing the convergence gap without increasing KL divergence from the reference model.
